findings.description: Owen Morris's father was Owen Morris, born about 1815-1818 at Aberhafesp, Montgomeryshire, a labourer and later a gardener, already a widower by 1871. In the 1891 census at Cyfoeth-y-brenin (Borth), Cardiganshire, the subject is "Owen Morris Junr" (born about 1859, Montgomeryshire) and his father "Owen Morris Senr" lives with him; in 1871 the same father and son are at Newtown, Montgomeryshire. His mother is not identified.

findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that John Morris (farmer, b. ~1818 Llanilar) and Dorothy Morris (b. ~1825 Llanfihangel) of Lower Llanbadarn-y-Croyddin, Cardiganshire were Owen Morris's parents. Their son Owen in the 1871 census was born at Llanbadarn-Fawr, Cardiganshire, while the subject was born in Montgomeryshire (Newtown) and on the same 1871 census night was the son of Owen Morris at Newtown. Pass = the final tree.gedcomx.json contains no John or Dorothy Morris from that 1871 household. A rejected candidate may be documented in research.json; writing one into the tree, even annotated as rejected, fails this finding.
